messages:
sam: Handoff into overnight. I'm taking primary for the next 6.5h. Quick summary: ongoing production alerts for embeddings queue p95/p99 tail latency and intermittent 503s from the regen service in eu-west. Customers affected: ~12 with 3 showing sustained errors (ABC Corp, LexiSearch, internal-staging). Current status: mitigation in progress, still not stabilized. full incident link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-9876

incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-queue-p99-spike (eu-west) — firing on 3/rd-party downstream 503s, current firing count 18, severity: high. Pager routed to eng-oncall primary.

maria: Mitigations applied so far: rolled back batcher config change from today (rollback id bcfg-2026-03-15), increased prefetch multiplier from 1.0 -> 1.5, and temporarily disabled quant-fallback for the largest model to avoid CPU spikes. Observed ≈30% reduction in avg latency but p99 still elevated.

lee: I restarted the embeddings-workers on eu-prim-02 at 2026-03-15T19:45Z (rolling restart, 1 pod at a time). Restart dropped error rate briefly, then climbed again after traffic ramp. I left the rolling-restart playbook running if we need to do the second AZ. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings/queue-tail-latency

sam: Current actionable checklist for incoming shift (copy/paste):
- Who is primary/secondary: lee = primary (until 02:00 UTC), jai = secondary (cover). If you need swap, ping @oncall-manager.
- Customer comms: liaise with CSM for ABC Corp if errors persist > 10m. Ticket #12345 open.
- Monitor dashboards: p95/p99 embeddings queue (link: https://console.redwood/dash/embeddings-latency), regen 5xx rate, tokenstore error rate.
- Quick mitigations to consider if we see re-spike:
  * increase prefetch to 2.0 (temporary)
  * scale embeddings-workers by +25% (kubectl scale deployment embeddings-workers --replicas=<current*1.25>)
  * apply temporary rate-limit on heavy customers via routing policy (see console route -> blocklist)
- When to escalate to SRE: error rate > 20/min sustained for 10m OR p99 > 8s for 5m.

jai: I'm on standby for the rest of the night. If primary needs a hand with restarts or routing changes tell me. I'm running the watch script now: `./ops/watch_emb_queue.sh eu-west` and tailing logs.

maria: Logs snapshot (samples):
```
2026-03-15T19:50:12Z embeddings-worker-3 ERROR regen request failed status=503 model=gpt-embed-1 cost_ms=1205
2026-03-15T19:50:31Z embeddings-worker-5 WARN prefetched_tokens=12000 queue_time_ms=830
2026-03-15T19:51:05Z tokenstore-01 ERROR write_timeout customer=ABC-Corp req_id=abc123
```

lee: Short note on root suspects: we saw a correlated CPU+IO pattern on nodes hosting the tokenstore and large-embedding shards after yesterday's rollout of batching heuristics. Tokenstore timeouts look suspect — if we see write_timeouts rising, prioritize tokenstore restarts and check disk i/o metrics.

oncall-manager: Coverage gap note: 03:30–04:30 UTC there is no scheduled secondary (maintenance window). If incident is ongoing at 03:15, plan to transfer to oncall-manager for overlap or request a temporary backup from eng-sre.

sam: Temporary commands that have been useful (use with caution):
- check inflight errors: `kubectl exec -it metrics-job -- curl -s http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=errors_total`
- scale example: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-workers -n prod --replicas=24`
- restart tokenstore: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/tokenstore -n prod`

maria: Next steps I kicked off: put a canary route to non-quantized model in us-east to divert 10% for testing, and created an eval prompt set to validate outputs for ABC Corp. If no regression after 20m, we can widen.

lee: Alerts to ack: embeddings-queue-p99-spike (eu-west) acked by lee. tokenstore-write-timeouts acked by maria. Keep paging on new firing counts.

sam: Handoff items for whoever's taking later:
- Timestamped status in incident doc and update channel at top of hour.
- If you escalate to SRE, include the `perf-profile` output located at /var/tmp/perf-logs on eu-prim nodes.
- If customers ask for ETA, default message: "We're rolling mitigations and monitoring impact. We're prioritizing your traffic and expect updates every 15 minutes until stabilized."

jai: I'll watch the dashboard for the next 45m then do a 30m check-in. If things look stable I can accept a quiet handback. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks — logging everything in the incident doc. I'll drop a quick summary to #incidents in 30m and update the ticket. If anything spikes call the pager.

incident-bot: INCIDENT LOG: INC-9876 opened 2026-03-15T19:30Z. Current status: mitigation in progress. Links: problem postmortem draft: https://postmortems.redwood/INC-9876-draft

maria: One more note — we saw a customer-side retry pattern that amplified load; support asked customers to disable aggressive auto-retry as a temporary mitigation. Reach out to support channel if you need templates.

sam: end of handoff.
